name: Agent
description: Uses an LLM to reason over flow state and produce text or structured JSON output.

inputs.name: endpoint
inputs.label: Endpoint URL (Optional)
inputs.helpText: Base URL (e.g. http://192.168.178.71:1234/v1) or full chat completions URL endpoint.

inputs.name: customTemperature
inputs.label: Custom Temperature
inputs.helpText: Override model default temperature. (Disabled by default for reasoning models)

inputs.name: reasoningEffort
inputs.label: Reasoning / Thinking
inputs.helpText: Control reasoning effort. 'Disable Thinking' turns off chain-of-thought tokens on supported models (e.g. Groq Qwen).

inputs.name: reasoningFormat
inputs.label: Reasoning Output Format
inputs.helpText: 'Hidden' prevents <think> tokens from polluting downstream prompts and breaking JSON mode.

inputs.name: enableTools
inputs.label: Enable Autonomous Tools
inputs.helpText: Allow the agent to autonomously call approved tools (search, read pages) to complete tasks.

inputs.name: allowedTools
inputs.label: Allowed Tools
inputs.placeholder: Choose allowed tools or bind variable...
inputs.helpText: Select registered tools this agent is authorized to call autonomously.

inputs.name: maxSteps
inputs.label: Max Tool Steps
inputs.helpText: Maximum number of autonomous tool calling iterations before concluding (1-20).

inputs.name: systemPrompt
inputs.label: System Prompt
inputs.placeholder: You are a helpful AI assistant in a LangGraph workflow...
inputs.helpText: Base system persona and behavioral guidelines. Click 'Revise' to improve with Flow Helper LLM.

inputs.name: userPrompt
inputs.label: User Prompt
inputs.helpText: Supports mustache templates like {{parser.value}} or {{trigger.input}}

inputs.name: enableAttachment
inputs.label: Attach File / Media
inputs.helpText: Attach an image, audio clip, PDF or document from your computer, an upstream variable, a URL, or a file in the project sandbox.

inputs.name: attachment
inputs.label: Attachment Source
inputs.placeholder: Upload a file, paste a URL or path, or select a variable
inputs.helpText: Upload File stores the file inline as a data URL. Variable accepts browser screenshots, File block output, or any upstream variable holding a URL, path or base64 payload.

inputs.name: maxSizeMb
inputs.label: Max Upload Size (MB)
inputs.helpText: Largest file accepted by the upload picker. Base64 inflates the saved graph by about a third, so keep this small.

inputs.name: attachmentType
inputs.label: Media Type
inputs.helpText: Auto Detect reads the mime type of the source. Set it explicitly only when the source has no usable file extension.

inputs.name: outputType
inputs.label: Zod Output Schema
inputs.helpText: Define schema using Zod or TypeScript, or use the 'Explain & Generate (AI)' tab to generate it with LLM. Properties are automatically exposed as downstream variables.

inputs.name: researchOutput
inputs.label: Validate Research Findings
inputs.helpText: Require the shared research findings schema. Invalid findings fail this Agent node with field-level errors.

inputs.name: cacheResult
inputs.label: Cache Last Result
inputs.helpText: Store the latest execution result in the database cache. When running in Debug mode with 'Use Cache' enabled, this cached result will be reused instead of calling the LLM.

inputs.name: memoryMode
inputs.label: Project Memory
inputs.helpText: Off: no memory. Agent decides: the model chooses when to call search_memory (optional LLM relevance filter below). Always search first: runs memory search before the agent answers and injects results into the prompt (still allows follow-up search_memory calls when tools are supported).

inputs.name: memorySearchQuery
inputs.label: Required memory search query
inputs.placeholder: Defaults to the user prompt when empty
inputs.helpText: Used only when Project Memory is "Always search first". Supports {{variables}}. When empty, the resolved user prompt is used as the search query.

inputs.name: memoryEmbeddingModel
inputs.label: Memory Embedding Model
inputs.helpText: Must be the same model the artifacts were indexed with (normally the default), otherwise similarity scores are 0. Falls back to keyword search if embeddings are unavailable.

inputs.name: memoryFilterModel
inputs.label: Relevance Filter Model (Optional)
inputs.helpText: Optional LLM judge: scores each memory hit and drops low-relevance results. Applies to the required preload search and to each search_memory tool call. Adds one small LLM call per search.

inputs.name: memoryMinScore
inputs.label: Minimum Similarity
inputs.helpText: Artifact chunks below this cosine similarity (0-1) are dropped. Raise it if irrelevant results show up; lower it if nothing is found.

inputs.name: memoryNamespace
inputs.label: Memory Namespace
inputs.helpText: Namespace of the remembered facts to search (and save to). Artifacts are always searched within the current project.

inputs.name: memoryAllowWrite
inputs.label: Allow Agent to Save Memories
inputs.helpText: Adds a remember_memory tool (max 5 saves per run). Saved keys are prefixed with 'agent:' so the agent can never overwrite memories saved by people or flows. Values that look like personal or payment data are refused.

inputs.name: validateOutput
inputs.label: Validate Output Against Schema
inputs.helpText: Validate the JSON response against the Output Schema. On mismatch the field-level errors are sent back to the model to correct; the node fails if it still does not match after the retries.

inputs.name: outputRetries
inputs.label: Correction Retries
inputs.helpText: How many times the model may correct an invalid response (0-5).

inputs.name: enableEvaluation
inputs.label: Evaluate Response (LLM Judge)
inputs.helpText: An evaluator model grades the answer against your criteria. Below the threshold, its problems are sent back to the agent (same conversation, so the prompt is served from cache) to repair.

inputs.name: evaluatorModel
inputs.label: Evaluator Model
inputs.helpText: Prefer a different (or stronger) model than the agent: models grade their own answers too generously. Empty = same model.

inputs.name: evaluationCriteria
inputs.label: Evaluation Criteria
inputs.placeholder:
[must] Answers the user's actual question
[must] Every factual claim cites a source URL
[should] Under 200 words
inputs.helpText: One criterion per line, prefixed [must] or [should]. Click 'Generate' to draft them from your prompts. Empty = the evaluator derives criteria from the task on every run.

inputs.name: evaluationThreshold
inputs.label: Pass Threshold (%)
inputs.helpText: Score needed to pass (0-100). Score = weighted share of passed criteria (must = 2, should = 1). All [must] criteria must also pass.

inputs.name: maxEvaluationRounds
inputs.label: Max Repair Rounds
inputs.helpText: How many times the agent may repair its answer (0-5). Stops early if a repair does not improve the score.
